facts.text: The hotel is housed within the Williams Building, a 20th-century landmark.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis San Francisco is housed within the Williams Building - a 20th century landmark combining architectural bravura with modern refinement.

facts.text: The building is home to the Museum of the African Diaspora (MoAD).
facts.excerpt: The artful location is home to the Museum of the African Diaspora (MoAD)

facts.text: The hotel is adjacent to the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA).
facts.excerpt: is situated adjacent to the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA)

facts.text: The hotel is in SoMa.
facts.excerpt: a Forbes Five-Star sanctuary in the heart of SoMa

facts.text: The spa spans 9,000 square feet across two levels.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 9,000 square feet across two levels

facts.text: The spa features cedar saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms and a Himalayan Salt Room.
facts.excerpt: featuring cedar saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms, a Himalayan Salt Room, and intimate relaxation lounges, complemented by access to the hotel’s indoor infinity pool

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Featuring cedar saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms, a Himalayan Salt Room, and access to the indoor infinity pool

facts.text: Astra serves modern American cuisine made with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Astra offers modern American cuisine crafted with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients in a relaxed, refined setting in the heart of San Francisco.

facts.text: The Golden Gate Mary is the hotel's local version of the St. Regis Bloody Mary, inspired by the sunset over the Pacific.
facts.excerpt: sip on the Golden Gate Mary, the local interpretation of the iconic St. Regis signature cocktail that is inspired by the sunset over the Pacific Ocean

facts.text: The Golden Gate Mary is made with tequila.
facts.excerpt: Red and orange ingredients-from tequila to chili pepper-give this libation the vermilion hue of a Pacific sunset.

facts.text: Champagne A La Carte at The St. Regis Bar features champagne and caviar pairings and oysters.
facts.excerpt: Champagne À La Carte is a curated ritual at The St. Regis Bar, featuring champagne and caviar pairings, oysters, and exquisite sweet delights.

facts.text: A champagne sabrage ceremony is presented each evening in the bar.
facts.excerpt: This signature ceremony of The St. Regis Evening Rituals series is presented each evening in The St. Regis San Francisco Bar.

facts.text: Afternoon tea in The Salon is inspired by Caroline Astor and features selections from TEALEAVES.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate the timeless tradition of Afternoon Tea, inspired by Caroline Astor’s legendary gatherings. Offered in The Salon Thursday through Sunday, the ritual features three curated selections from TEALEAVES with exquisite pairings.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is offered Thursday through Saturday.
facts.excerpt: Join the tradition of afternoon tea Thursday through Saturday afternoons in the Tea Salon for a timeless experience inspired by Caroline Astor.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is offered Thursday through Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Offered Thursday-Sunday 2-4PM. Guests must make reservations at least 24 hours in advance.

facts.text: The art collection features works by local artists.
facts.excerpt: The discerning art collection at The St. Regis San Francisco features exquisite works by acclaimed local artists

facts.text: Child-sized robes and slippers are available, and the Astor Library Cart offers children's books for bedtime reading.
facts.excerpt: Child-sized robes and slippers are available for the little ones, and The Astor Library Cart provides a collection of children's books to select from for bedtime reading.

facts.text: Suite guests receive St. Regis Butler service, including unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoe shine.
facts.excerpt: For our Suite guests, unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoe shine are a few of the everyday services provided by the gracious Butlers at The St. Regis San Francisco.

facts.text: A complimentary house car offers drop-offs within a 2-mile radius on select evenings, first come, first served.
facts.excerpt: guests enjoy complimentary access to the luxury house car available select evenings. The courtesy car is available on a first-come, first-served basis for complimentary drop-offs within a 2-mile radius of the hotel.

facts.text: The St. Regis Suites are on the 19th and 20th floors and have views of San Francisco Bay.
facts.excerpt: The exclusive St. Regis Suites sit on the 19th and 20th floors and offer 1,500 square feet of refined living space. Each suite features views of the financial district's skyscrapers, the San Francisco peninsula's rolling hills, San Francisco Bay

facts.text: Overlook suites have views of the Overlook Terrace and Yerba Buena Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Overlook suites feature views of the Overlook Terrace and the Yerba Buena Gardens.

facts.text: Parking is valet only.
facts.excerpt: Valet Parking only. Garage height is 6'10".

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome but not in the restaurant, bar, spa, pool or fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Dogs only. Not allowed in the restaurant, bar, spa, pool or fitness center.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Moscone Center and the Yerba Buena Center for the Arts.
facts.excerpt: It's also walking distance to the Moscone Center, and the Yerba Buena Center for the Arts.

facts.text: Guests can request a personal trainer at the gym.
facts.excerpt: has pretty spectacular city views—and you can request your own personal trainer.

facts.text: Bathrooms have soaking tubs and separate shower areas.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms have soaking tubs and separate shower areas, rainforest shower heads, lighted make-up mirrors, and plush robes.

facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: The room service menu is extensive, and served 24 hours.

facts.text: The hotel has a Yoga and Meditation Room.
facts.excerpt: Center your practice and be present through meditation in this dedicated space.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the best hotel in downtown San Francisco.
facts.excerpt: A landmark of luxury and the best hotel in downtown San Francisco

facts.text: The hotel is a Forbes Five-Star hotel.
facts.excerpt: a Forbes Five-Star sanctuary in the heart of SoMa
